sample.fixture: Five-file demo repository with intentionally stale guidance
sample.note: This is a reproducible product example, not a claim about a real repository.

findings.title: Deployment config lacks an explicit no-deploy or approval rule
findings.detail: vercel.json exists, but guidance does not explicitly block or require approval for deployment.

suggestion.description: Add a deployment safety rule to the agent guidance.
suggestion.patch: Add: Do not deploy or modify production deployment state without explicit user approval.

findings.title: Guidance uses pnpm, but package.json declares npm
findings.detail: pnpm test conflicts with the repository's declared npm package manager.

evidence.excerpt: Run `pnpm test` and `npm run deploy` before handoff.

suggestion.description: Use the declared npm package manager in agent commands.
suggestion.patch: Replace "pnpm test" with the equivalent npm command.

findings.title: Guidance references missing package script "deploy"
findings.detail: npm run deploy is documented, but package.json does not define a deploy script.

evidence.excerpt: Run `pnpm test` and `npm run deploy` before handoff.

suggestion.description: Use an existing package.json script or add the missing script intentionally.
suggestion.patch: Replace "npm run deploy" with a defined script such as "lint", "test".

findings.title: Guidance references missing path "src/retired.ts"
findings.detail: AGENTS.md points to src/retired.ts, but that path is not present in the repository inventory.

suggestion.description: Remove stale path guidance or update it to the current repository path.
suggestion.patch: Replace or delete the reference to src/retired.ts.

findings.detail: Placeholder guidance weakens deterministic agent behavior.
